status_detail: Mountain City leaders had advanced a 30 MW bitcoin mine on a 50-acre parcel, but at the August 2025 Board of Mayor and Aldermen vote all members abstained on the rezoning resolution; the mayor told WUOT 'Bitcoin is dead in the city limits.' County-level authority to restrict future crypto/data centers later failed, leaving potential relocation elsewhere in Johnson County unclear.
notes: DCD and WUOT identify the proposal as a 30 MW facility on 50 acres at/near 178 Rainbow Road. Status set rejected for Mountain City city-limits proposal; county article notes CleanSpark could still look elsewhere in Johnson County.
